# The `my.*` options

<!-- Generated by `nix run .#write-docs` from the option declarations; do not edit. -->

Per-machine settings. Shared modules read `config.my.*` instead of
hard-coding the user, domain, addresses or devices; a host sets them in
`modules/hosts/<name>/default.nix`. Defaults are the declared ones, as
the template host sees them.

## my\.ambilight\.enable

Whether to enable HyperHDR ambient lighting from screen capture\.



*Type:*
boolean



*Default:*

```nix
false
```



*Example:*

```nix
true
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.ambilight\.musicSink



PipeWire sink whose output HyperHDR captures for music effects (` pw-cli ls Node `)\.



*Type:*
null or string



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"alsa_output.usb-iFi__by_AMR__iFi__by_AMR__HD_USB_Audio_0003-00.analog-stereo"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.ambilight\.wledUrl



WLED controller the dashboard’s ambilight buttons switch\.



*Type:*
null or string matching the pattern https?://\[^ ]+



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"http://192.168.1.50"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)

*Default:*

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/approval/default\.nix](../modules/approval/default.nix)

## my\.controlDaemon\.actions



The policy, per action: get-power-profile, set-power-profile, sleep, power-off, reboot-windows, or a
desktop command forwarded to erebor-desktopd as ` desktop.<command> `\.
An action not listed is refused, except read-only ones
(` get-* `, ` list-* `, ` status `), which any caller may run\.



*Type:*
attribute set of (submodule)



*Default:*

```nix
{ }
```



*Example:*

```nix
{
  set-power-profile.approval = "none";
  reboot-windows = {
    approval = "approve";
    callers.local = "none";
    origins.dashboard = "approve";
  };
  "desktop.set-noctalia-preset".approval = "none";
}

```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/control-daemon/default\.nix](../modules/control-daemon/default.nix)



## my\.controlDaemon\.actions\.\<name>\.approval



` none ` runs it, ` approve ` asks approvald first, ` deny ` refuses it\.



*Type:*
one of “none”, “approve”, “deny”



*Default:*

```nix
"deny"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/control-daemon/default\.nix](../modules/control-daemon/default.nix)



## my\.controlDaemon\.actions\.\<name>\.callers



Per caller (a name in ` callers `), replacing ` approval `\.

{ }

## my\.dashboard\.settingsFile



The dashboard’s cards and actions (JSON)\. In it, @host@ and @Host@ become

*Type:*
absolute path



*Default:*

```



*Example:*

../../../home/dashboard-settings.json
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.externalDrives\.hiddenFromNextcloud



Folders on those drives, as \<name>/\<path>, that Nextcloud’s www-data
cannot read\. One unreadable folder makes Nextcloud mark the whole
“External drives” storage unavailable, so each is covered with an empty
read-only folder in the container; each must exist on its drive\.



*Type:*
list of string



*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```



*Example:*

```nix
[
  "media/lost+found"
]
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.externalDrives\.names



Drives mounted at /srv/external/\<name> (by the host’s storage config),
shared read-only with Jellyfin and Nextcloud and read-write with
qBittorrent when those services are on\.



*Type:*
list of string matching the pattern \[A-Za-z0-9\._-]+



*Default:*

```nix
[ ]
```



*Example:*

```nix
[
  "media"
  "backup"
]
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)



## my\.flakePath



Checkout of this repository that live desktop configs link to
(Umbriel, Noctalia, the Zed keymap)\. Home Manager points
those files at it with out-of-store symlinks, so saving the file there
applies the change without a rebuild\. Null links the store copies
instead (no checkout needed; edits need a rebuild); my\.taskBoard,
my\.shellTasks and my\.updateBranch, which read the checkout, then cannot
be enabled\.



*Type:*
null or string matching the pattern /\.\*



*Default:*

```nix
null
```



*Example:*

```nix
"/etc/nixos"
```

*Declared by:*
 - [modules/my\.nix](../modules/my.nix)
